hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 custom curve hook implementing Pendle-style fixed-rate yield trading for Principal Tokens. Executes the full AMM swap in beforeSwap using a custom curve and returns a BeforeSwapDelta. Swaps are gated by a per-pool maturity expiry (block.timestamp) and an optional curator-controlled pause. Supports optional ERC4626 vault rehypothecation for LP yield enhancement.
